component.name: KDOS Add-ons
component.summary: Wallpapers, colour schemes, Konsole schemes, window scripts and widgets, reviewed for KDOS

description.p: The curated set KDOS ships in place of KDE's online "Get New…" store. Everything in it installs into the places Plasma already reads, so the Wallpaper, Colours, Konsole, KWin Scripts and widget pages list it as soon as it is installed.

ul.li: Four wallpapers in the KDOS accents, each with a light and a dark picture
Eight colour schemes for Plasma and Konsole: VGA, Nord, Dracula, Gruvbox Dark and Light, Tokyo Night, Catppuccin Mocha and Latte
Two window scripts: picture-in-picture video on top, and new windows on the pointer's screen
Two widgets: the Phosphor Clock and a Focus Timer
